messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, following the movement shown in the motion reference video. Retain the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, as demonstrated in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a paved road, initially looking forward, then turns his head to look up and to the side, and finally crosses his arms while looking down.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot that keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A light blue and white plaid button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, brown leather suspenders, grey plaid trousers, orange socks, and brown leather shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black, with a distinct green section at the back.","hairstyle":"Short dark hair with a small green ponytail or topknot at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered adult male character with a medium-brown complexion, short dark hair, and a short beard.","scene":"An outdoor urban environment under a concrete overpass or bridge, with a metal railing, red and yellow striped bollards, and a construction crane visible in the background under a blue sky with clouds."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output character now performs a thoughtful sequence: looking upward, turning, raising a hand to the chin, and crossing the other arm, then returning to a neutral standing pose. The character's clothing, green ponytail, facial features, overpass scene, and static low-angle camera remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to a thoughtful standing pose following the reference motion, while retaining identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression, and leaving scene and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the subtle facial expression exactly matches the source throughout the new pose.
unexpected_changes: The character's body orientation and arm positions differ from the source during the middle of the clip, as expected from the action replacement.
